newsitem.title: UK: Sotheby's names Conrad Black to board.
newsitem.headline: Sotheby's names Conrad Black to board.

text.p: Auctioneers Sotheby's Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it named Canadian media tycoon Conrad Black to its board of directors, effective immediately.
Black, chairman of Hollinger Inc and owner of the Daily Telegraph, will also serve as a member of the board's audit and compensation committee, Sotheby's said in a statement.
Earlier this month, the venerable auction house launched an internal review of its practices after allegations here that it smuggled art treasures from Italy to Britain.
The firm's European arm admitted that the law had been broken and suspended senior staff after a television report.
